content: VERIFIED from official docs (better-auth.com/docs/authentication/email-password, fetched 2026-09-08): Better Auth default password hashing is scrypt. Custom hashing configured at emailAndPassword.password.hash and password.verify (hash(password string); verify({password, hash})). Passwords are stored in the account table with providerId set to credential. Docs page does not cover migrating existing hashes - must be designed manually; hash-prefix detection and rehash-on-login are community patterns (unverified). Existing bcrypt users are locked out unless a custom bcrypt verify is wired BEFORE cutover.
